content_fields.title: Limit container privileges
content_fields.description: Remove privileged mode and the SYS_ADMIN capability and run with all capabilities dropped.
content_fields.finding: The web container runs privileged and additionally requests the SYS_ADMIN capability.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    privileged: false
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    user: "10001:10001"
criteria: All capabilities are dropped and only those proven necessary are added back individually.
The application runs correctly with the reduced capability set.
